div.div: فُغْمٌ and ↓ فُغُمٌ The mouth, altogether: or the chin with the two lateral portions of its jaw; (K, TA; [i. e. بِلَحْيَيْهِ; for which the CK has بلِحْيَتِهِ;]) and so فُقْمٌ: (TA:) or, accord. to Sh, فُغْمٌ signifies the nose: but accord. to Kr, it is ↓ فَغْمٌ that has this meaning. (TA.) أَخَذَ بِفُغْمِهِ, a phrase mentioned by AZ, is expl. as meaning He took hold of his chin together with the two lateral portions of its jaw: or, accord. to Sh, it means he took hold of his nose: (TA:) or it means (assumed tropical:) he distressed, afflicted, troubled, or molested, him. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
